title: Affiliate Manager
description:
ABOUT TRADEIFY 247

Tradeify is a fast-growing trading company built to help traders access the tools, technology, and opportunities they need to succeed. We combine a trader-first approach with modern technology to create a reliable, transparent, and engaging experience for our growing community.

Tradeify 247 is our team focused on crypto, tokenized assets, and forex markets, bringing that same approach to a global audience. We operate at the intersection of finance and technology, and we move quickly.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for an Affiliate Manager to build and grow the affiliate and partner channel for Tradeify 247. You’ll own the program end to end: recruiting new partners, supporting existing ones, tracking performance, and making sure the channel brings in quality traders at a healthy cost of acquisition. You’ll work closely with our marketing, compliance, and finance teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- 2-4 years of experience managing affiliate or partner programs, ideally in crypto, forex, prop trading, or another financial services or fintech vertical

- Hands-on experience with affiliate tracking platforms (e.g., Post Affiliate Pro, Tapfiliate, Cellxpert, Income Access, or similar)

- Strong analytical skills and comfort working with performance data and reporting

- Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills

- Clear written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus

- Understanding of financial marketing compliance requirements

- Self-starter who is comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, remote environment

NICE TO HAVE

- Existing relationships with affiliates or KOLs in the crypto or trading space

- Experience in the retail trading, prop trading, or crypto industry

- Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools

- Experience running affiliate events or attending industry expos

WHAT WE OFFER

- Join a professional-grade trading firm at a pivotal stage of growth

- Work with and learn from experienced traders across multiple asset classes

- High-performance culture that rewards ownership, curiosity, and results

- Access to premium market data tools, exchange infrastructure, and industry resources

- Competitive base salary, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits

A NOTE ON OUR HIRING PROCESS

At Tradeify 247, we use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruiting process, which may include resume screening, application review, and candidate communication. We want all applicants to be aware of this upfront so you can make an informed decision about applying. Final hiring decisions are always made by a member of our team.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our classified software team. You will design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.

This is a hands-on role with real technical authority. You will be the first dedicated software engineer on this team, which means you set the architecture, choose the patterns, and establish the engineering standards the rest of the team builds to. • Design and build production web applications in React and Go that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.

• Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.

• Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.

• Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.

• Decompose multi-quarter programs into well-scoped work other engineers can deliver independently, and grow the engineers who join the team through design review, code review, and pairing.

• Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.

• Professional experience developing backend services in Go.

• Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.

• Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.

• Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.
